title: #HITB2012KUL D1T3 - The Grugq - OPSEC: Because Jail is for wuftpd
channel: Hack In The Box Security Conference
summary: The Grugq's Hack In The Box 2012 talk on operational security for hackers, drawing on hacker indictments and counter-intelligence research. It reviews OPSEC goals and methods for avoiding detection and arrest, with case studies of how hackers got caught.
why: HN treats it as the go-to talk on OPSEC and pseudonymity, recommended in threads about Tor, Silk Road and staying anonymous online.

quote.text: It's a great watch if you're interested in how various (in)famous hackers thought they were secure and got busted anyway.
